name: availability-report
title: Squad availability report
for_each: select id, name from squads order by code

sections.title: Out
sections.sql: select v.name as athlete, v.position, v.diagnosis, v.reported_on as since, v.expected_return from availability v join athletes a on a.id = v.athlete_id where a.squad_id = $1 and v.status = 'out' order by v.expected_return nulls last

sections.title: Modified training
sections.note: Available for the parts of training their physio has signed off. No contact.
sections.sql: select v.name as athlete, v.position, v.diagnosis, v.expected_return from availability v join athletes a on a.id = v.athlete_id where a.squad_id = $1 and v.status = 'modified' order by v.name

sections.title: Available
sections.sql: select v.name as athlete, v.position from availability v join athletes a on a.id = v.athlete_id where a.squad_id = $1 and v.status = 'available' order by v.position, v.name

sections.title: Concussion return dates
sections.note: Not before these dates, and only with a doctor's clearance.
sections.sql: select c.athlete, c.contact_ok_from as contact_training_from, c.competition_ok_from as competition_from, c.doctor_cleared from concussion_status c join athletes a on a.id = c.athlete_id where a.squad_id = $1 and c.status <> 'cleared'

name: return-to-play
title: Return-to-play record
for_each: select i.id, a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name || ' ' || i.number as label from injuries i join athletes a on a.id = i.athlete_id where i.status <> 'cleared' or i.reported_on > current_date - 60 order by i.number

sections.title: The injury
sections.sql: select number, athlete, squad, reported_on, body_area, side, mechanism, activity, diagnosis, status from injury_register where id = $1

sections.title: Graded return
sections.sql: select r.stage, r.name, r.completed_on, s.name as signed_by, s.role from rtp_stages r left join staff s on s.id = r.signed_by where r.injury_id = $1 order by r.stage

sections.title: Concussion dates
sections.note: Blank when the injury is not a concussion.
sections.sql: select symptoms_resolved_on as symptom_free_from, free_days_needed as symptom_free_days_needed, contact_ok_from as contact_training_from, competition_ok_from as competition_from from concussion_status where id = $1

sections.title: Clearance
sections.sql: select cleared_on, cleared_by_name as cleared_by, cleared_by_role as role, expected_return from injury_register where id = $1

name: testing-report
title: Athlete testing report
for_each: select a.id, a.first_name || ' ' || a.last_name as name from athletes a where a.status = 'active' and exists (select 1 from test_results r where r.athlete_id = a.id) order by a.code

sections.title: Latest results
sections.note: Change against the previous test, judged against the squad's smallest worthwhile change.
sections.sql: select test_name as test, tested_on, value || ' ' || unit as result, previous, change, squad_avg as squad_average, swc as smallest_worthwhile_change, verdict from test_changes where athlete_id = $1 order by test

sections.title: Training load, last four weeks
sections.sql: select date_trunc('week', day)::date as week_of, sum(sessions) as sessions, round(sum(load)) as load from daily_load where athlete_id = $1 and day > current_date - 28 group by 1 order by 1
